data.name: Crown Chained
data.detailed_description:
Core Gameplay: Exploration, Capture, and Survival

Vast Exploration & Companion Collection
Embark on an endless adventure and unlock brand-new maps, each with its own unique style. Along the way, you will encounter various hostile targets. You may choose to subdue them through brute force, or win them over with attentive care — either way, bringing these unique characters into your ranks and constantly iterating your team composition is the key to becoming stronger.

Debt Crisis & High-Stakes Gambles
The game features a unique "debt survival" mechanic. You must regularly repay accumulating principal and interest. Will you play it safe and avoid defaulting, or take on heavy debt in exchange for greater opportunities and powerful allies? This is a double-edged sword: if your debt grows too large, you will face extremely challenging forced battles, and only the truly strong can turn crisis into opportunity.

Relaxed Auto-Battle System
Combat features deep pre-battle strategic setup and fully automated battles. While freeing up your hands, you can even use your spare time to handle other tasks, easily enjoying the thrill of strategic command. A vast array of weapons, equipment, and random events will add endless variables to your adventure.

Multi-Playthrough Fate Choices
Every choice you make matters. The final fate of each region depends entirely on your "favorability" with it. The game features rich content for both the first and second playthroughs — only by completing the full cycle can you piece together the final truth and ending of this world.

data.short_description: From zero to legend — write your own epic comeback. Play as a fallen soul, build your team with loyal companions, overcome impossible odds, and reclaim your glory to rise to the top again.
